blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Images under non-uniform coupled degradations require diverse restoration capabilities for different degraded regions. Existing methods employ globally uniform operations, potentially overlooking regional differences and causing incomplete restoration or even damage to image content. Moreover, a degraded region may require successive restoration actions, and earlier actions may alter residual degradation characteristics or introduce artifacts, potentially hindering subsequent restoration. To address these challenges, we propose RegionAgent, an adaptive restoration framework that trains a Vision-Language Model (VLM) through two-stage preference learning to generate a region-specific restoration action at each iteration. Specifically, we first train the VLM to select an action suited to the current region through step-level Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), using preferences derived from immediate restoration feedback to supervise only the differing component in each action pair. To account for the effects of current actions on subsequent restoration, we then apply trajectory-level DPO, using preferences derived from complete trajectory scores to supervise the sole differing action in each trajectory pair. Furthermore, as conventional image-pair datasets do not directly provide preferences over regional restoration decisions, we construct a regional restoration preference dataset comprising 10K action pairs and 20K trajectory pairs for two-stage VLM training. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate strong restoration performance under both mixed and single degradations. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of two-stage preference learning in improving restoration quality.
blocks.zh: 非统一情况下的图像结合退化需要不同的退化区域具有不同的恢复能力。 现有方法采用全球统一操作,可能忽略区域差异,造成图像内容的修复甚至损害不完整。 此外,退化区域可能需要连续的恢复行动,而早期行动可能改变残余退化特征或引进文物,从而可能妨碍随后的恢复。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议区域代理人,通过两个阶段的偏好学习,培训一个远景-语言模型,在每个周期产生一个针对区域的恢复行动。 具体来说,我们首先通过步骤级直接偏好优化(DPO)来训练VLM来选择适合当前区域的动作,利用从即时恢复反馈中得出的偏好,只监督每个动作配对中不同的组件. 为了说明当前行动对后续恢复的影响,我们然后采用轨迹等级的DPO,利用从完整轨迹分数中得出的偏好来监督每对轨迹中唯一不同的动作. 此外,由于传统的图像-图像数据集并不直接提供优于区域恢复决定的偏好,我们构建了一个区域恢复偏好数据集,由10K对动作和20K对轨迹组成,用于两级VLM培训。 跨越多个数据集的实验表明,在混合降解和单一降解下,恢复性能强劲。 校对研究进一步验证了两阶段优先学习在提高修复质量方面的有效性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Image restoration aims to recover clean images from observations affected by degradations such as blur, haze, rain, or low light. Deep learning-based methods have advanced this task through specialized models for individual degradation types ( Ren et al., 2021 ; Zamir et al., 2021 ; Yan et al., 2025 ) and all-in-one networks for multiple restoration tasks ( Li et al., 2022 ; Potlapalli et al., 2023 ) (Figure 1 (a)). However, real-world images can contain coupled degradations that vary in type and severity across regions. Applying uniform restoration operations to the whole image may overlook regional differences and damage unaffected content. Within an affected region, removing one degradation can leave others unresolved, requiring successive restoration operations. The effectiveness of later operations then depends on how earlier ones change the image ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 图像修复旨在从受到模糊,雾霾,雨水,或低光等退化影响的观测中恢复清洁图像. 深入的学习方法通过个人降解类型的专门模型(Ren等人,2021年;Zamir等人,2021年;Yan等人,2025年)和多重恢复任务的全能网络(Li等人,2022年;Potlapali等人,2023年)(图1(a))。 然而,现实世界的图像可能包含不同区域在类型和严重程度上各不相同的连带退化。 对整个图像采用统一的恢复操作可能会忽略区域差异和损害未受影响的内容。 在受影响的区域内,消除一种退化可能使其他退化问题得不到解决,需要连续开展恢复行动。 然后,后期操作的有效性取决于早期操作如何改变形象(Chen等人,2024年;Zhu等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: To make restoration more adaptive, instruction-guided methods allow users to specify restoration goals ( Conde et al., 2024 ) and target regions ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Restoration agents automate tool selection and revise image-level plans using restoration feedback ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) (Figure 1 (b)). As an alternative to sequential tool invocation, Beyond Sequential Tools learns image-level expert weights through preference optimization for single-pass restoration ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) . However, these approaches focus on user-specified regions or image-level decisions, rather than learning to select regions and configure their restoration autonomously.
blocks.zh: 为了使恢复更具适应性,指导性方法允许用户具体说明恢复目标(Conde等人,2024年)和目标区域(Liu等人,2025年)。 恢复剂将工具选择自动化,并利用恢复反馈修订图像级别计划(Chen等人,2024年;Zhu等人,2025年;Lin等人,2025年)(图1(b))。 作为顺序工具引用的替代方法,Beyond Sequentive Tools通过对单通道恢复的偏好优化来学习图像级专家权重(Xiong等人,2026年). 然而,这些方法侧重于用户指定区域或图像层面的决定,而不是学习选择区域并自主配置其恢复。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Conceptual comparison of restoration paradigms. (a) Task-specific and all-in-one models restore the whole image. (b) Image-level agents select tools using iterative feedback. (c) RegionAgent selects regions and expert configurations for adaptive local refinement.
blocks.zh: 图 1:修复范式的概念比较. (a) 特定任务和全一模型恢复整个图像。 (b) 图像级代理人利用迭代反馈选择工具。 (c) 区域代理人选择区域和专家配置,以适应当地情况。

blocks.en: We therefore introduce RegionAgent , an adaptive restoration framework in which a Vision-Language Model (VLM) selects regions and configures their restoration from the current image state (Figure 1 (c)). At each iteration, a localization network predicts a heatmap of residual degradations and uses it to propose candidate regions (Figure 2 ). The VLM then selects one of these regions and specifies its restoration configuration based on the current image.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们引入了区域代理(Region Agent),这是一个适应性的恢复框架,其中视觉语言模型(VLM)从当前图像状态中选择区域并配置它们的恢复(图1(c))。 在每次迭代时,一个局部化网络预测残余退化的热图,并利用它提出候选区域(图2 )。 VLM然后选择其中的一个区域,并根据当前图像指定其恢复配置.

blocks.en: Each refinement action specifies a target region, weights for combining restoration experts, and the strength of the local correction. We train the VLM through two stages of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) : step-level DPO followed by trajectory-level DPO. Step-level DPO learns which configuration choices suit the current region by comparing their immediate restoration effects, applying the preference loss only to the component that differs between paired actions. Trajectory-level DPO then trains the VLM to account for the effects of current choices on subsequent restoration. It uses complete-trajectory scores to supervise the sole differing action between paired trajectories. Since conventional image-pair datasets lack preferences over regional restoration decisions, we construct a dataset of action and trajectory preference pairs for two-stage training.
blocks.zh: 每次完善行动都明确了目标区域,合并修复专家的权重,以及当地矫正的力度. 我们通过直接偏好优化(DPO)的两个阶段(Rafailov等人,2023年)对VLM进行训练:步骤级DPO,然后是轨迹级DPO. 步骤级DPO通过比较其即时恢复效果,仅将偏好损失应用于对偶动作不同的组件,从而了解哪些配置选择适合当前区域. 轨迹级DPO然后训练VLM,以说明当前选择对后续恢复的影响. 它使用完整的导轨分数来监督配对轨迹之间唯一的不同动作. 由于传统的图像-图像数据集缺乏对区域恢复决定的偏好,我们构建了用于两阶段培训的行动和轨迹偏好数据集。

blocks.en: Executing these actions produces restored crops whose direct writeback can introduce boundary artifacts and structural discontinuities. Our Degradation- and Structure-Guided Residual Fusion Module (DSRF) integrates the difference between each restored crop and its current counterpart as a residual correction. Spatial masks regulate this correction according to restoration needs and image structure, while Laplacian pyramid blending promotes smooth transitions across scales. The VLM then generates its next action from the fused image.
blocks.zh: 执行这些行动会产生恢复的作物,这些作物的直接回函可以引入边界文物和结构上的不连续性。 我们的降解和结构指导残余物聚合模块将每个恢复的作物与其目前的对应物之间的差别作为剩余修正。 空间面具根据修复需要和图像结构来调节这种校正,而拉普拉西亚金字塔混合则促进跨尺度平稳过渡. VLM随后从被熔化的图像中生成其下一个动作.

blocks.en: Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate strong restoration performance under both mixed and single degradations. Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We introduce RegionAgent, an adaptive restoration framework whose VLM generates regional actions from the current image state to address non-uniform coupled degradations. • We develop two-stage DPO: step-level DPO adapts restoration configurations to current regional needs, while trajectory-level DPO uses complete-trajectory feedback to guide current restoration actions. • We construct a regional restoration preference dataset comprising 10K action pairs and 20K trajectory pairs. It includes controlled comparisons that vary a single configuration component or a single trajectory action, providing targeted supervision for regional restoration decisions beyond conventional degraded–clean image pairs.
blocks.zh: 跨越多个数据集的实验表明,在混合降解和单一降解下,恢复性能强劲。 • 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们引入了区域代理人,这是一个适应性的恢复框架,其VLM从目前图像状态产生区域行动,以解决非统一结合的退化问题。 我们开发了两阶段的DPO:步骤级DPO将恢复配置适应当前的区域需求,而轨迹级DPO则使用完整的导电反馈来指导当前的恢复行动. ^ 我们建造了一个区域恢复优先数据集,包括10K动作对和20K轨迹对。 它包括可控比较,这种比较可改变单一的配置部分或单一的轨迹行动,为常规退化的清洁图像对齐以外的区域恢复决定提供有针对性的监督。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: All-in-one models condition shared restoration networks on degradation representations and learned prompts ( Li et al., 2022 ; Potlapalli et al., 2023 ) , while vision-language approaches incorporate visual-textual features for degradation diagnosis and restoration guidance ( Luo et al., 2024 ; Ai et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ) . Instruction-guided methods extend this control to user-defined goals ( Conde et al., 2024 ) and region-specific restoration ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Restoration agents automate tool selection and sequencing ( Yu et al., 2018 ) , using multimodal diagnosis and quality feedback to revise their plans ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) . Recent systems integrate restoration with assessment ( Chen et al., 2026 ) or couple planners with LoRA-based tools ( Li et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , while OPERA jointly optimizes planning and tool execution using restoration rewards ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . As an alternative to sequential execution, Beyond Sequential Tools learns image-level expert weights for single-pass restoration through a DPO-trained allocation branch ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) . RegionAgent instead selects regions and configures their restoration autonomously from the updated image at each iteration.
blocks.zh: 全一模型条件在降解表达和学习提示上共享恢复网络(Li等人,2022年;Potlapalli等人,2023年),而视觉语言方法包含降解诊断和恢复指导的视觉文字特征(Luo等人,2024年;Ai等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2024年)。 指令性指导方法将这种控制延伸到用户定义的目标(Conde等人,2024年)和特定区域的恢复(Liu等人,2025年)。 恢复剂将工具选择和测序自动化(Yu等人,2018年),利用多式联运诊断和质量反馈修改计划(Chen等人,2024年;Zhu等人,2025年;Lin等人,2025年). 最近的系统将恢复与评估结合起来(Chen等人,2026年),或将基于LORA的工具纳入夫妇规划(Li等人,2026a年); Liu et al., 2026 ),而OPERA则通过恢复奖励共同优化规划和工具执行(Zhu et al., 2026 ). 作为顺序执行的替代办法,Beyond Sequencetic Tools通过一个经过DPO训练的分配分支(Xiong等人,2026年)学习图像级专家加权数,用于单通道修复. 区域代理则选择区域,并从每个迭代的更新图像中自主配置它们的恢复.

blocks.en: Preference optimization applies to restoration outputs and decision policies. DSPO aligns super-resolution generators with semantic-instance preferences ( Cai et al., 2025 ) , whereas TTPO guides diffusion sampling with test-time preferences without model training ( Li et al., 2026b ) . Within policy outputs, fine-grained objectives weight tokens or target localized differences ( Christopoulou et al., 2025 ; Hasan et al., 2025 ) , and DiTTo separates preference supervision across degradation reasoning, restoration order, and tool calls ( Choi and Oh, 2026 ) . For sequential decisions, Hierarchical Preference Learning combines trajectory-, step-, and action-group objectives ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , while Critical Step Optimization uses successful policy continuations to verify alternative actions for action-level DPO ( Li et al., 2026c ) . Our refinement pairs vary one configuration component from a shared image state; trajectory pairs vary one action while fixing the region and other actions. The losses target the differing component and full action, respectively.
blocks.zh: 优化优惠适用于恢复产出和决策政策。 DSPO将超分辨率发电机与语义学偏好相配合(Cai等人,2025年),而TTPO指导传播采样与测试时间偏好不经过模型训练(Li等人,2026年b). 在政策产出中,精细目标权重标志或目标局部差异(Christopoluou等人,2025年;Hasan等人,2025年)和Ditto将优惠监督从退化推理、恢复秩序和工具呼叫中分离出来(Choi和Oh,2026年)。 对于顺序决定,等级优先学习结合了轨迹、步骤和动作组目标(Gao等人,2026年),而关键步骤优化则利用成功的政策延续来验证行动级DPO的替代行动(Li等人,2026c年)。 我们的完善配对从一个共享的图像状态来改变一个配置组件;轨迹配对在固定区域和其他动作时改变一个动作. 损失分别针对不同的部分和全面行动。

blocks.en: 3.4 Supervision Construction
blocks.zh: 3.4 监督建筑

blocks.en: Conventional image-pair datasets provide degraded images and clean targets, but do not directly provide preferences over regional restoration decisions. We therefore construct a regional restoration preference dataset containing action and trajectory pairs to support two-stage DPO.
blocks.zh: 常规图像-图像数据集提供退化的图像和清洁目标,但并不直接提供优于区域恢复决定的偏好。 因此,我们建立了一个区域恢复优先数据集,其中包含行动和轨迹对,以支持两阶段的DPO。

blocks.en: To control search cost, we first restore each newly proposed region with one expert at a time, with every trial starting from the same current image. We fuse each restored crop at the allowed fusion strengths and score the resulting images using the one-step utility U step U_{\mathrm{step}} , which measures restoration gains relative to the current image after accounting for penalties. We rank regions by their highest utility across these trials and expand expert configurations in the top two regions.
blocks.zh: 为了控制搜索费用,我们首先将每个新提出的区域恢复一次有一名专家,每次试验都从同一当前图像开始。 我们以允许的聚变强度将每个恢复的作物熔化,并使用U_{\mathrm{step}}}的一步功用(U_{\mathrm{step}})对产生的图像进行分数,该分数在计算惩罚后衡量与当前图像相比的恢复收益。 在这些试验中,我们以最高的用途对各区域进行排名,并在前两个区域扩大专家配置。

blocks.en: The one-step utility U step U_{\mathrm{step}} uses three full-reference metrics (PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS) and three no-reference metrics (MANIQA, MUSIQ, and CLIP-IQA). We normalize and clip each metric gain separately. For full-reference metrics, we equally combine full-image and selected-region gains, whereas no-reference metrics use full-image gains. We average the resulting gains across the six metrics and subtract penalties for halo degradation, boundary artifacts, action cost, repeated states, and degradation below Base.

blocks.en: We form step-level pairs from same-state actions. To construct a trajectory pair, we replace one refinement action in a completed search trajectory while keeping its target region fixed, then execute the unchanged subsequent actions from the resulting image state. The original and modified trajectories therefore differ in exactly one action, while subsequent image states may differ. Filtering enforces pairing constraints and executability, removes duplicates, and balances degradation and decision coverage. Pairs meeting score-gap thresholds are selected automatically; low-margin or metric-conflicting cases undergo VLM-assisted screening and human verification. The best trajectories form the demonstration set 𝒟 SFT \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{SFT}} for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and retained action and trajectory pairs form 𝒟 step \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{step}} and 𝒟 traj \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{traj}} .
blocks.zh: 我们从同态动作中形成阶梯级对. 为了构建一个轨迹对,我们将在完成的搜索轨迹中替换一个精细动作,同时保持其目标区域固定,然后执行由此产生的图像状态中未变的随后动作. 因此,原轨和修改的轨迹完全在一个动作上有所不同,而随后的图像状态可能有所不同. 过滤可强制进行配对限制和可执行性,消除重复,平衡退化和决策范围。 符合得分-差距阈值的对等是自动选定的;低边距或公尺冲突的情况经过VLM协助的筛选和人类核查。 最佳的轨迹构成演示设置 D SFT\ mathcal{ D}_{\ mathrm{ SFT} 用于有监督的微调( SFT), 并保留动作和轨迹对 组成 D step\ mathcal{ D}_{\ mathrm{ step} 和 D tray\ mathcal{ D}_{\ mathrm{ traj} 。

Their one-step utilities determine the preference, and 𝒯 \mathcal{T} selects that field’s value tokens, including the full expert-weight vector for weight comparisons. For STOP – REFINE pairs, complete-trajectory scores compare immediate termination with continued restoration, while 𝒯 \mathcal{T} selects only the action value tokens. blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Settings

blocks.en: Evaluation benchmarks. We evaluate mixed degradations on AgenticIR’s MiO100-derived benchmark ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ) , which applies degradation operators sequentially to each source image, and single degradations on RAR’s eight-dataset suite ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS measure fidelity to the clean image, while CLIP-IQA, MUSIQ, and MANIQA provide no-reference quality estimates ( Wang et al., 2004 ; Zhang et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Ke et al., 2021 ; Yang et al., 2022 ) . blocks.en: Implementation details. We train the VLM Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) with SFT followed by step-level and trajectory-level DPO. The framework combines an OSEDiff-based shared restorer ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , four LoRA experts, and a frozen U-Net Localizer ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) . Inference permits at most T max = 8 T_{\max}=8 REFINE actions, stopping earlier on STOP . Experiments run on NVIDIA A100 GPUs.

blocks.en: Preference optimization. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present RegionAgent, an adaptive restoration framework that uses a VLM to generate region-specific restoration actions for images with non-uniform coupled degradations. To address the lack of preferences over regional restoration decisions in conventional image-pair datasets, we construct a dataset of action and trajectory preference pairs. Using these pairs, step-level DPO first trains the VLM to select configurations suited to current regional needs. Trajectory-level DPO then uses complete-trajectory feedback to train the VLM to account for the effects of current actions on subsequent restoration. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate strong restoration performance under both mixed and single degradations, while ablation studies validate the effectiveness of two-stage preference learning.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍区域代理人,这是一个适应性的恢复框架,使用甚高分辨率辐射计为非统一结合退化的图像采取针对具体区域的恢复行动。 为了解决传统图像拍摄数据集中缺乏对区域恢复决定的偏好,我们构建了一套行动和轨迹偏好对的数据集。 利用这些配对,步级DPO首先会训练VLM来选择适合当前区域需要的配置. 轨迹级DPO随后使用完整的轨迹反馈来训练VLM,以说明当前行动对后续恢复的影响. 跨越多个数据集的实验显示在混合降解和单降解下都有强的恢复性能,而衰减研究验证了两阶段偏好学习的有效性.
